text: 2026年10月16日至17日，国际货币基金组织在泰国曼谷召开第54届国际货币与金融委员会（IMFC）会议，会议讨论了全球经济金融形势、基金组织工作等议题。中国人民银行行长潘功胜指出，贸易摩擦和保护主义通过影响供应链、推升通胀、扰乱市场预期等因素拖累全球经济。同时，新一轮科技革命和产业变革加速突破，既蕴含巨大机遇，也面临治理挑战。各国应加强政策协同，降低经营主体面临的不确定性，坚定支持多边贸易体制，抵制一切形式的保护主义措施。中方愿继续深化与基金组织的合作，共同维护全球经济金融稳定。
text_en: From October 16 to 17, 2026, the International Monetary Fund held the 54th meeting of the International Monetary and Financial Committee (IMFC) in Bangkok, Thailand. The meeting discussed the global economic and financial situation, the work of the Fund and other topics. PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng pointed out that trade frictions and protectionism weigh on the global economy by affecting supply chains, pushing up inflation and disrupting market expectations. At the same time, a new round of technological revolution and industrial transformation is accelerating, embodying both enormous opportunities and governance challenges. Countries should strengthen policy coordination, reduce the uncertainty facing business entities, firmly support the multilateral trading system and resist protectionist measures in all forms. China is willing to continue deepening cooperation with the Fund and jointly safeguard global economic and financial stability.
